internal.title: High Latency Incident in ad Service Due to CPU Resource Exhaustion
internal.body:
At 10:49 UTC on 2026-11-08, we received an alert for high latency in the ad service. Investigation revealed that the service was experiencing CPU resource exhaustion, with CPU utilization reaching 98%, causing p95 latency to spike to approximately 1800 ms. Memory usage remained stable, ruling out memory leaks. The issue was linked to a recent configuration flag change that increased CPU load.

At 11:09 UTC, the team proposed disabling the flag responsible for the high CPU usage. After approval, the flag was disabled, resulting in a rapid recovery of latency metrics to normal levels (p95 latency reduced to ~120 ms).

The incident was resolved promptly with no significant error rate increase (0.2%). No error injection or other fault types were found to contribute to the issue.

Actions taken:
- Diagnosed CPU resource exhaustion as root cause
- Disabled the high CPU usage flag
- Verified recovery through latency metrics

Please review the postmortem for detailed analysis and lessons learned.

external.title: High Latency Issue in ad Service Resolved
external.body: Between 10:49 and 11:09 UTC on 2026-11-08, the ad service experienced elevated latency, causing slower response times for users. The issue was identified as high CPU usage in the service, which was addressed by adjusting service configuration. The latency returned to normal shortly after the fix was applied. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and are taking steps to prevent recurrence.
